items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: I went to Japan with Art Blakey in ‘69 I think it was, yeah it was ‘69, going into ‘70.

ctx.x: Well I wanted to ask you, you mentioned that you have a birthday coming up. And you said two of them.

Well this is the story on that. I went to Japan with Art Blakey in ‘69 I think it was, yeah it was ‘69, going into ‘70. It was New Year’s Eve when we were flying. But before I got my passport I sent away for my passport and it was taking so long, and I was wondering what’s wrong, what’s happening. So I was born November 25, 1928. When I got the passport I was born October 15th 1927, that’s what they said. Now my mother told me my date, I believed my mother, but for important or legal things, I have to take…
Tell me about this recent recording. After all these years what prompted the tribute to Buddy?
